ideas.title: Minnesota Campaign Finance Investigations
ideas.description: Investigate recent FBI inquiries into Republican campaign finance discrepancies and potential ties to larger corruption schemes.
questions: What are the details of the discrepancies?
Are there similar cases in other states?
How do these discrepancies relate to larger patterns of corruption?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover deeper patterns of corruption and potentially lead to high-profile convictions or reforms.

ideas.title: Vaccine Policy Lawsuit Analysis
ideas.description: Analyze the lawsuits filed by Minnesota and other states against the Trump administration over vaccine policy changes.
questions: What are the specific vaccine policy changes in question?
How have these changes impacted public health?
What are the potential long-term effects of these policy changes?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal important information about the impact of vaccine policy changes on public health and potentially lead to reforms.
